A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the uniaxial orientation of donor and acceptor moieties in TPDCDTS is a key to the efficient charge generation and transport in vacuum-deposited thin films.
the coplanar dithienosiloletriphenylamine (TPDTS) donor with the dithienosilene as π-spacer has been found to be an effective donor material for SMOSC.
the donor material TPDCDTS with uniaxially anisotropic structure has shown a promising potential for vacuum-deposited SMOSCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the coplanar D-π-A structure of the donor molecule with a strong intramolecular charge transfer is a key for the high efficiency in SMOSC.
the use of the donor-acceptor molecules with uniaxially anisotropic molecular shape is a very promising way to enhance the performance of SMOSCs.
the incorporation of dithienosilene as a central π-unit of the donor material is a promising strategy to enhance the power conversion efficiency of vacuum-deposited SMOSC.
